title: Cover named-root late events through adopted and Windows early observation close
outcome: Named-root file event attribution is covered across the adopted two-step close and the Windows early close, in addition to ordinary completion.
acceptance: A behavioral adopted-turn test closes the actual observation before a separate terminal finish, then delivers a named-root event and asserts the completed turn's FileChanges summary with unchanged ownership.
A Windows early-close behavioral test covers the same scope retention where platform ownership permits it; any unavailable platform setup is explicitly recorded.
